notes: Kinds of professional and service provider that rules can point customers to ('who can help'). Reviewed like code: a changed entry updates the database on the next migrate, and a removed entry is deactivated, never deleted. Keys are permanent: rules and, later, partners and leads refer to them.

categories.label: Town planner
categories.description: Advises on planning schemes and prepares development applications.

categories.label: Building certifier
categories.description: Assesses building work against the building rules and issues building approvals.

categories.label: Cadastral (land) surveyor
categories.description: Surveys boundaries and prepares plans of subdivision.

categories.label: Geotechnical engineer
categories.description: Assesses soil, slope and site stability.

categories.label: Architect or building designer
categories.description: Designs buildings and fit-outs and prepares drawings.

categories.label: Licensed builder
categories.description: Carries out building and fit-out work under a builder's licence.

categories.label: Licensed electrician
categories.description: Carries out electrical work under an electrical contractor licence.

categories.label: Licensed plumber
categories.description: Carries out plumbing and drainage work under a plumbing licence.

categories.label: Lawyer
categories.description: Gives legal advice, for example on leases, licences and structures.

categories.label: Accountant or registered tax agent
categories.description: Helps with registrations (ABN, GST, PAYG withholding), tax and business structure.

categories.label: Bookkeeper or BAS agent
categories.description: Keeps the books, payroll and activity statements.

categories.label: Insurance broker
categories.description: Arranges business insurance such as public liability and workers' compensation cover.

categories.label: Food safety consultant
categories.description: Helps a food business set up its food safety practices, training and records.

categories.label: Food safety auditor
categories.description: Audits food safety programs for businesses that must have one.

categories.label: Liquor licensing consultant
categories.description: Prepares liquor licence and permit applications.

categories.label: Work health and safety consultant
categories.description: Helps an employer set up safe work practices and meet safety duties.

categories.label: Infection control trainer
categories.description: Trains personal appearance service operators in infection control.

categories.label: Early childhood education and care consultant
categories.description: Helps prepare provider and service approval applications for education and care services.

categories.label: Marine surveyor
categories.description: Surveys domestic commercial vessels.

categories.label: Naval architect
categories.description: Designs vessels and prepares plans, stability and structural assessments for survey.

categories.label: Marine safety consultant
categories.description: Helps operators of commercial vessels write and maintain their safety management system and prepare for AMSA applications.

categories.label: Maritime training provider
categories.description: Trains crew towards maritime certificates of competency and licences.

categories.label: Conveyancer
categories.description: Handles the legal transfer of property.

categories.label: Grant writer
categories.description: Prepares grant applications.

categories.label: Property manager
categories.description: Manages residential tenancies for owners: agreements, bonds, inspections, repairs and notices.

categories.label: Pool safety inspector
categories.description: Inspects pool barriers and issues pool safety certificates.

categories.label: Smoke alarm technician
categories.description: Checks, tests and replaces smoke alarms against the current standard (hardwired alarms need a licensed electrician).

categories.label: Licensed customs broker
categories.description: Classifies imported goods, works out duty and GST, and lodges import and export declarations with the Australian Border Force for you.

categories.label: Freight forwarder
categories.description: Books and coordinates international sea and air freight, and the paperwork that goes with it.

categories.label: Logistics and warehousing provider
categories.description: Moves, stores and delivers goods within Australia, including container transport, warehousing and fulfilment.

categories.label: Import and export compliance consultant
categories.description: Helps with permits, biosecurity conditions, export registrations and product rules for goods crossing the border.
